age.evidence: Male C57BL/6J mice at the age of 9 weeks (purchased from Jackson Laboratories, Bar Harbor, ME, USA) were used for all experiments.

sex.evidence: Male C57BL/6J mice at the age of 9 weeks (purchased from Jackson Laboratories, Bar Harbor, ME, USA) were used for all experiments.

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin (obtained from Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA) was diluted with 0.9% sterile saline and administered to each mouse via i.p. injection at 3 mg/kg.

handling.evidence: We initiated the procedure by acclimating the mice to the experimenter's handling for 3 days to reduce nonspecific effects.

group_housing.evidence: Mice were housed under standard laboratory conditions (lights on from 07:00 to 19:00; temperature at 23 ± 2 °C; humidity at 55-60%) with ad libitum access to food pellets and water. Cage density not stated.

day_night_flipped.evidence: Mice were housed under standard laboratory conditions (lights on from 07:00 to 19:00...)

enrichment_housing.evidence: Mice were housed under standard laboratory conditions; no enrichment items described.

assays.assay_description: After i.p. saline or psilocybin (3 mg/kg), mice were placed in an open-field arena/behavioral chamber and video-recorded for 120 min. DeepLabCut pose estimation (ResNet-50) tracked body points; total distance traveled and per-minute locomotor speed were computed from the mid-back point.

application_type.evidence: administered to each mouse via i.p. injection at 3 mg/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: Only handling acclimation described: 'acclimating the mice to the experimenter's handling for 3 days'; no apparatus pre-exposure described.

setup_restrain.evidence: We then placed the mice in the behavioral chambers to video-record locomotor activities for 120 min.

food_restriction.evidence: Open-field arena/behavioral chamber; no food described in the testing apparatus (ad libitum food in home cage).

water_restriction.evidence: Open-field arena/behavioral chamber; no water described in the testing apparatus (ad libitum water in home cage).

time_to_assay.evidence: On the experimental day, we randomly assigned the mice to receive either saline or psilocybin (3 mg/kg) injection. ... We then placed the mice in the behavioral chambers to video-record locomotor activities for 120 min.

sample_size.evidence: n = 7 each, 2-way Repeated-Measure ANOVA with Sidak's post hoc tests (Figure 1 legend).

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (3 mg/kg, i.p.) acutely reduced locomotor activity in male mice: cumulative distance traveled and per-minute speed were significantly lower than in saline controls. The speed effect emerged ~15 min, peaked ~20 min, and largely resolved by ~60 min after injection.
outcomes.statistics: Total distance: psilocybin x time interaction F(118, 1416) = 21.58, p < 0.0001; 38-120 min post-psilocybin vs. saline, p < 0.05 or 0.01. Speed: psilocybin x time interaction F(118, 1416) = 3.660, p < 0.0001; 15-55 min post-psilocybin vs. saline, p < 0.05 or 0.01 (two-way repeated-measures ANOVA with Sidak post-test).
outcomes.evidence: These results suggest that psilocybin administered at the dose of 3 mg/kg acutely decreases the locomotor activity in mice.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Total distance (pixels) traveled ... Locomotor speed (pixels per frame per min) measured by the 'middle back' coordinates for the 2-h period.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: For per-minute locomotor metrics, speed values were averaged within each minute ... this effect emerged rapidly (~15 min), peaked at ~20 min, and largely resolved by ~60 min after injection.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No sequential, transitional, or bout-structure analyses described; only distance and speed computed.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only locomotor distance and speed were measured.

B5_social.evidence: Open-field locomotion assay; no social component.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Locomotor activity; no learning or memory requirement.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Behavioral tracking was performed using DeepLabCut ... trained using 90 manually labeled frames to detect the following body points: head, neck, ears, middle back, tail root, and mid-tail.

B8_multivariate.evidence: No dimensionality reduction or multivariate analysis across behavioural features reported.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Mice were either placed in an open field arena to monitor locomotion or placed back into their home cage.

E2_shelter.evidence: not reported; no shelter described in the open field arena

E7_social_context.evidence: We then placed the mice in the behavioral chambers to video-record locomotor activities; no conspecific described as present.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in the open-field arena during recording.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline recording described; mice were injected and then placed in the chambers.
